scenarios.name: Add a checker texture to a generic appearance

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: a generic appearance has no image selected
I choose Checker from the Generic Image menu
a separate Texture Editor opens with a checker preview
the appearance shows an image in its Generic Image slot
the Texture Editor shows Color 1, Color 2 and Soften
its transforms include position, scale and horizontal and vertical repeat controls
the preview shows the sample dimensions
